The [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Haka Hai]] controlled a Criminal '''gang''' by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The group operated out of a [[Haka Hai's compound|compound]] among st the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. In 19 BBY Hai agreed to buy an artifact known as the [[Dreypa's Oubliette|Jebble Box]] from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Schurk-Heren]], but then used the gang to [[Skirmish on Mimban|ambush]] Him and take tHe box witout paying. During the ambush a faction of the gang, lead by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Lumbra]] betrayed Hai and took the box for themselves before escaping. Those remaining loyal to Hai stayed with Him on Mimban and took Schurk-Heren's crew captive, but were eventually all killed by their prisoners when they escaped. The traitorous faction met their end instead at the hands of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] on a [[Unidentified jungle moon (K'Kruhk)|moon]] where they crashed.
